CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates and origin/representation metadata are both explicitly given for the same referent (p0/current/n3).

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate lists name content and color attributes (red/blue) for specific referents.

D.rationale: Origin/representation status metadata is attached to the same identified content, separating identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit orientation instructions and origin/representation fields describe how content is presented and represented.
